responsibility: This header declares the recording class hierarchy that underlies the public libgccjit API. It defines recording::context and its factories for all JIT objects, the memento-based object model for types/functions/blocks/rvalues/statements/cases/asm/top-level asm/global initializers, option and command-line recording, replay hooks into the playback layer, and utility predicates such as types_kinda_same. It is the principal internal API for the long-lived JIT IR exposed through libgccjit entrypoints.
same_name_distinction: Declares the recording::context and memento class hierarchy that jit-recording.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file, it provides the internal type and API definitions for the persistent pre-compilation IR and replay hooks, rather than the dump, source-replay, and executable replay method bodies.
